entries.title: The Bouncer

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 with an owned PS2 copy for higher internal resolution and modern display options.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 presentation with optional emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: The Bouncer was released for PlayStation 2 and no sourced higher-fidelity port, remaster, or remake was identified, so the original PS2 release is the complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original PS2 disc on compatible hardware, or use PCSX2 with an owned copy for modern display options.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release of Square and DreamFactory's cinematic beat 'em up/action RPG.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and therefore the complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate release was identified; the PlayStation 2 release is both the original and complete version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced official remaster, remake, or modern rerelease was identified.
